game_title: Fallback: String Glue – Cinder Cone Camp
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must hold off ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Then check spell_ok and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obsidian gate from ember hounds in Cinder Cone Camp: keep spell_ok above zero until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 7, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
